role: P3 HELD — the parity diagnostic. The I-SP memo's §4 point-to-set-vs-point-to-point flag is ESCALATED by owner ruling from 'logged, not acted on' to a decisive disqualification test of ξ-as-built. Sealed BEFORE the diagnostic runs.
extends: v17 (three-pole calibration, QUALIFIED corr). Supersedes ONLY the I-SP memo §4 disposition ('logged, not acted on'); the I-SP memo itself stands as written.

escalation_provenance.flag: I-SP memo (Pebble-ISP-susceptibility.md) §4: reach is formally the POINT-TO-SET correlation length, not the POINT-TO-POINT (pairwise) one; ξ-as-built (both observables) computes a pairwise object.
escalation_provenance.reason: Montanari-Semerjian (cond-mat/0603018), quoted in the I-SP memo: the relevant length is defined by point-to-set, not point-to-point, correlations; the pairwise length can stay FINITE while the point-to-set length DIVERGES, and pure >=3-ary PARITY is the extreme case — ZERO pairwise correlation, FULL point-to-set correlation. Parity is our long pole's family.
escalation_provenance.why_the_P2_calibration_could_not_catch_i: the long pole was 2-ARY affine, where pairwise and point-to-set COINCIDE (corr = 0.5, deterministic). The instrument's blind spot is invisible exactly there. The build chose 2-affine BECAUSE 3-XOR read zero (locked in test_parity_blind_but_2affine_visible) and MISCLASSIFIED that as a pole-selection technicality rather than a disqualifying scope fact. The parallel I-SP investigation surfaced what the main line's calibration structurally concealed.

the_diagnostic.run_before_anything_else: cheap, existing rig; nothing else in P3 runs until this returns.
the_diagnostic.measure: corr reach_score on a PURE 3-ary parity family (3-XOR) and a PURE 4-ary parity family (4-XOR), via the same corr rig the calibration used.
the_diagnostic.density_adaptation_declared: 3-XOR is UNSAT at the calibration density alpha=1.4 (above its ~0.918 satisfiability threshold), so parity is measured in its SATISFIABLE regime (alpha=0.6, n=16) where the affine coset is rich (~2^6 solutions). Because pairwise blindness to parity is DENSITY-INDEPENDENT (a 3-way relation has ~0 pairwise correlation at any SAT density), the diagnostic is robust to this. A same-density (alpha=0.6, n=16) 2-affine reference (R_EQ) is measured alongside to CONTROL for density: the reference is pairwise-visible and should read high at the same density.
the_diagnostic.solutions: exact — enumerate the coset at n=16 (2^16 feasible), so no sampler noise contaminates the verdict.

sealed_prediction_from_literature_not_ou: near-zero corr reach_score for 3-XOR and 4-XOR DESPITE maximal (global, affine) point-to-set propagation — XOR-SAT solution cosets are globally rigid (a spanning set of variables determines all others by parity), so point-to-set reach spans the connected component while the pairwise correlation is ~0. Predicted from Montanari-Semerjian, sealed before measurement.

DISQUALIFIED.trigger: max(3-XOR, 4-XOR reach_score) < the medium pole (0.074) AND << the same-density 2-affine reference — i.e. globally-rigid parity reaches LESS than a bounded-width 2-SAT family, the disqualifying inversion.
DISQUALIFIED.consequence: ξ-as-built is DISQUALIFIED for the substrate hypothesis, NOT merely limited. The P2 PASS STANDS but is RESCOPED: the instrument correctly orders PAIRWISE correlation — a real quantity, and NOT the one 'reach' means. P3's sweep would systematically MISPLACE every parity-flavored family, so it does NOT run in this form.
DISQUALIFIED.design_fork_gets_its_own_decision: either (a) build a POINT-TO-SET instrument (condition on a far BOUNDARY SET, not a single variable — MS Eq. 6 / MRT reconstruction give the definition) — a NEW instrument with its OWN prereg, poles, and qualification; or (b) stop the propagation line and write Pebble up as an instrument-development chapter with a located design flaw (a legitimate outcome, NOT a failure). Owner decides; NO silent redesign.

PROCEEDS_WITH_CAVEAT.trigger: parity reach_score >= the medium pole (0.074) — the blind spot does not materially bite on our roster's parity families at these sizes.
PROCEEDS_WITH_CAVEAT.consequence: document WHY (finite-size effect / our specific ensembles), and P3 proceeds with the pairwise-vs-point-to-set distinction stated as a LIVE caveat rather than a resolved one.

standing_discipline: prereg (this v20) sealed before the diagnostic; prediction taken from the literature, not our data
P3 sweep HELD until the diagnostic returns
if DISQUALIFIED, a point-to-set instrument is a NEW instrument (own prereg/poles/qualification) — no silent redesign; the write-up-as-instrument-development outcome is legitimate
